description: Object holding information necessary to realize path aliasing.
Path aliasing is configured in $SGE_ROOT/$SGE_CELL/sge_aliases and/or $HOME/.sge_aliases

attributes.name: origin
description: The original path before applying aliasing.

attributes.name: submit_host
description: The host from which the job was submitted.

attributes.name: translation
description: The path after applying path aliasing.
